content: Jeji wakagraga ga wa chiwograga

Gi rixanu Tokanchi Yokanatkaluruya gi wetpotutawalu psoluko kiglerkaka wa waneyapwu. Mayawle pixka wetyalu wa kamrutkalurkakatka. Gi wetawalu gi pixka rixpotuta. Giyagni waleko giylatkalurkaka pawalapumnunanuka mutuka genekjetkotu, gi pagogneko rumkata mmagatikane gixkakletna kayegikachine.
Wane rixkamka ¿gi ge rutuka ganika genekashletmakna? Gi rixanu pakatapje powratkoklunmakna kyonogiklerune, gi wa kmukochirerune rumata getletinmakwana.
Seyni tyekakaya pawalapumnunanuka rushinkapka mukochri.
Gi rixanu jeji wakagraga ga wa chiwograga gi gimkata kaspukletlu mukochri.
Genekashlu giylatkalurni wa Gesomane
Giyagni tyechijne rakanginitka Geso, wane china:

Wa rogwaka chinyawaka, “Genekashlu giylatkalurkaka ga wa ganika genekashletkalurkaka, ga wa genekashlukaka psoluyako yochpiikaluru, ga wa genekashlukaka mukochri chinanu, gi paluka. Gi koxa pugleretlu. Tyekaka Tokanchi Yokanatkaluru chinyawaka ganikjetkaluru.”
Wanepnute wane china, “Petanu. Gewno Gita, wa pushinikyawaka nkamrutinripa.” Wa muchinanu genekashlukaka konatka, gepi chininri rutakyapa.
Wane rixa gishinikletyawaka chinanu kpashirine gixkaakalunwu, Geso Kristomane pakatapje ganika genekashletkaluru chinanu.
Satupje ganika genekashlewlu giylatkaluru
Ga wa pejnuruneko sasertotene pagognemnunanuka tunwa kamrurewlenata. Ga wa gixo kata rumepe ganiklejetluna walekotnaka giylatkalurkaka. Tyekaka gi gimkata konretlu mukochri.
Seyni Geso pakatapje ganiklu giylatkalurupa mukochri chinanu. Wanekluyakawa Goyakalu potuklesretate tuplagognenatatka,
wanepnute kagwakinripa kamnixjene gijixipta rapukote gitaakoklunpotunanuko.
Gi rixanu satupje ganika genekashlewlu chinanu mmagatikane rixkakgognenatna wa kpashirine gitaakalune.
Ga wa Giwekikaluru Kpashiri koxa gipgujtatwu. Gi rixanu wane chininitka:

content.text: Ga wa mukochirna ga wa pnu rixlena

content: Gi rixanu wa tyekaka kaspukikowaka, waneklu maleshatkalu ganika genekashlu mukochri chinanu.
Gerotu gatnugapo ga wa gatnugapo giwekachri
Giyagni, nomolene, gi wa popiklerunekwu kpashiwaka wjigloka Gesograga chinanu,
gerotu gatnugapoya ga wa gatnugapo giwekachriya. Walenwa wjigloka Wale kamrutanru gerotu wixa chinanu wa gimaletachrichrataya. Tyenwa Gesomane.
Ga wa gi rixanu tsru potu sasertote Gitsrukatpotu waneywu wchinini Goyakalupji chinanu, wkayegikanru.

Wkayegikanru potukgajirunepwu ga wa kgaponshinikanuklerunpotupwu walixlewle chinanu. Gitslaptaagajitkalunepwu Gesogragaya giklukanuwnanshinikanutnachinwa muglenchiya wma mixinitipa. Ga wa gerkamanetkalunepwu gonu powragaluyma.
Poyegirunwu womkagi gipgujtaletlu wkagwakanrupirana. Gi rixanu poyagkakachrinwa gipiratachri.
Wyanshinikanyegkakpotutanu, wkomyekanshinikankakinripa wushiniklewatinripa ga wa kigleru kamrurchi wkamrutinripa.
Gi wa wkaspuka gapatjeretanu wa pimrine gixjetyawaka pixka. Ga wa wanepnute gixa gapatjeretanu ga wa giykokakanu wa geta kayegikgogneretinpatkalu, wa Gitsrukachigognepa.
Giklukanuwnayegjixlewlupa wa wixako wushinikanuya wmukochirewatinipa
Gi rixanu wali yoptoretinitkalu wa galikakpotunanu tokanchi ga wa wumatinitkalu, wixako wushinikanuya wmukochirewatinipa, wanepnute gi wa rawatka genekashlu giylatkalurupa mukochri chinanu,
seyni giklukanuwnayegjixlewlu kagwakikolu tsru pikluyma, ga wa xirnachri pixkalutu jgekanchi wa kamnixlewatachine kamakatachripa.
Moysisi tokanu yokanatkaluru giknokachri gepi, mapa gipgujtatachine chinanu rupnanu metwamonutkotu.

Giyagni ¿gi pixkalutunanukta salewakchi gkagwakyalu rumuknu retikolupa wa Goyakalu Wgene gektutetachri, ga wa Giwekikaluru gimutlewatachri geyikachri? Walenwa granchi gimuteru kagwakachri, wa gipiratkaluru tokanchi chinpiranyegitanru granchi. Walenwa kpashiri rutakjeru gipiratkaluru tokanchi.
Gi rixanu wumatlu wa wane chinachri:
Wanepnute wanechinatnaka:
Piikalurpotupni wa yineru gijrukini, wa Goyakalu giwekachrimyo rapokinri.
Wumkata kashnantaklegognenata walixgognenatinri
Seyni gishinkapanru muchinanugognekaka, gepokamlatyegitkoklunu, wa gkashnantakgognenatyawaklu tsru yagotlu nsalewninrikakaya.
Psoji wa gixa yangikolu ga wa pejnurune getanu nsaletikolu. Ga wa psoji waneko pixka pnumnu gixkoklunu gixa gimatanune.
Gi rixanu gimata getwamonretna gostutkalune. Ga wa gimuwatachingi wane gixle getasha konretka. Gi rixanu gixa gimatlu wa wanepnute kigleru ga wa gwagognenatachrikaka waneygi.
Giyagni gi giknokanru gaponshinikanrewle wa wale chinanu waneplu tsru gapnutikolu.
Gi rixanu gixa gimkata kashnantaklegognenata. Wa Goyakalu gishinikanru gkamrutinpatka, gyoptotanru wa gipiratkaluru.
Seyni wixa gi wa yoxigikachinwu wamginripmaka, seyni galixachinwu waneya wixinripa wuwekinri.
